correctness.rationale: For distinguishable walkers H=aJ⊗I+bI⊗J, the all-coincidence detector span splits by distinct eigenspaces; its orthogonal complement is the maximal dark H-invariant subspace, and strict dissipation on the observable part gives eventual loss independent of positive detector rates. J has ±sqrt(pq) modes and zero-sum class subspaces U_A,U_B; zero-energy detector Gram blocks G_r=(δij−1/r)^2 have positive eigenvalues (r−1)/r and (r−2)/r for r>=3. Unequal speeds give N+4+4(N−2)=5N−4 observed dimensions; equal speeds merge sign-zero sectors, leaving N+2(N−2)+2=3N−2. At a/b=2 or 1/2 extra energy coincidences mix inequivalent trivial/standard permutation representations, so detector ranks still add. Explicit Gram inverse contributions give all three localized off-diagonal classes plus unit absorption at coincidences. Fresh independent Hermitian spectral projections for p,q=(3,3),(3,4),(4,4) and 5 equal/unequal ratios verified 15 rank and every diagonal probability case to <1e−8; that finite check is not an all-size proof.
